entries.english:
Correspondence of the Lords von Rosenberg with their advocates in various legal matters.

Term: 1559–1639.

Contains, among other things: 1. fols. 1–49, Friedrich Brosamer, court and territorial court procurator at Würzburg, 1572–1577; 2. fols. 50–65, Daniel Seger, court and territorial court procurator at Würzburg, 1572–1578; 3. fols. 66–75, Dr Wolfgang Rösch zu Schweinfurt, 1590–1593; 4. fols. 76–100, Dr Sebastian Dieterich zu Schwäbisch Hall, 1597–1607, 1621–1632; 5. fols. 135–148, Dr Lukas Goll zu Speyer, 1625; 6. fols. 149–217, lawsuit before the Imperial Chamber Court between Dr Amandus Wolf zu Speyer as plaintiff and Zaisolf von Rosenberg over unpaid remuneration, 1559–1564; 7. fols. 218–263, lists of legal cases of the Lords von Rosenberg.

Extent: 1 volume, fols. 1–271.
